extracted.intended_audience: scholars and advanced students of the history and methodology of science (readers of Bacon's Novum Organum); philosophers of science and experimentalists interested in methodological taxonomy
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting and applying Bacon's taxonomy of 'instantiarum' (27 praerogatives) and related methodological rules for selecting, collecting, and using experimental instances in natural philosophy. Includes guidance on informational vs. operational uses of instance-types and procedural priorities for building comparative tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Solitariae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives) cited among the list of instance-types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed among the 27 instantiarum; later described as accelerating the exclusion of a form (i.e., helping the intellect by narrowing hypotheses). Use as an informational instance to aid intellect by speeding exclusion of candidate forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Migrantes
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as helping the intellect by 'angustiando et propius indicando affirmativam formae' — i.e., narrowing and more closely indicating an affirmative form. Use to refine and approach the true form by transitional/ migrating examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Ostensivae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grouped with Migrantes and Comitatus as instances that indicate affirmative forms; they serve to show by example what to affirm about a nature—informational role to indicate the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Clandestinae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as able to raise the intellect and lead to genera/natures immediately (i.e., provide revealing cases). Use as informational instances that produce immediate intellectual advancement (reveal hidden aspects).

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Constitutivae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to lead the intellect by a proximate step ('gradu proximo') — intermediate instances that help move from particulars toward general form step-by-step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Conformes
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as giving help at the lowest degree ('gradu infimo') to lead the intellect to genera; relatively less decisive than Constitutivae.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Monodieae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: (OCR variant of 'Monodicae') Treated with Clandestinae and Foederis as instances that may elevate intellect immediately; collect early as high-value instances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Deviantes
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serve to rectify the intellect against habitual or customary errors ('rectificando intellectum a consuetis'). Use counter‑instances to expose and correct false generalisations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Lwiitaneae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: (OCR variant of 'Limitaneae' / boundary instances). Described as leading to the 'Forma Magna' or Fabricam Universi — boundary/limiting instances that guide to grander forms; treat with care when generalising.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Potestatis
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operative role: these instances indicate 'a quibus incipiendum' — by which points to begin practice/operation. Use them to determine practical starting points for applied experiments or interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Comitatus et Hostiles
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comitatus (accompaniment) and Hostiles (antagonistic instances) help indicate affirmative or negative relationships; they are used to show associations or antagonisms among phenomena (informational use).

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Subjunctivae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grouped with Comitatus; used in indicating or testing subordinate/conditional relations; serve to refine or test hypotheses about conditions for phenomena.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Foederis
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Considered among instances that immediately raise intellect to genera/natures (like Clandestinae and Monodicae). Use as evidential cases of alliance/union between properties or bodies that reveal form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Cruets
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed among the 27; used to caution about false forms/causes (see 'Crucis' earlier reference). Treat such instances as tests that can expose false attributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Divortii
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to separate/conceive divorces of properties or causes — helpful in cautioning against false forms and determining separations of intertwined causes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Januae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Act as 'gates' — instrumental instances that open routes of inquiry; listed among those to be collected early when assembling comparison tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Ciiantes
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: (OCR artifact; listed among the 27). Treated as part of the set that can assist intellect or practice depending on context; collect and record in tables for interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Viae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instances that indicate 'ways' or methods; practical value in showing routes of operation or transformation (operational use).

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Snpplementi
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ('Supplementi') Provide supplemental information for interpretation or practice; include in comparative collections to fill gaps and support induction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Persecantes
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instances that 'pursue' or stress differences — useful to press distinctions and pursue a nature through successive contrasts; valuable for narrowing hypotheses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Virgae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the four 'Mathematicae' (mathematical/measuring instances). Virgae and Curriculi (and two others) are used to measure and quantify—apply for mensuration and precise evaluation of effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Curriculi
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Another of the mathematical/mensurative instances; used to measure and enumerate motions/effects (part of the four mathematical instances alongside Virgae, Quanti, Luctae).

rubrics_metrics.name: Doses Natnrae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives) (OCR of 'Doses Naturae').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instances concerning natural 'doses' or quantities (part of the mensurative/mathematical group). Use to determine appropriate amounts and proportional relations in experiments and remedies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Luctae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of the four mathematical instances (listed as Virgae, Curriculi, Quanti/Luctae, and another); used for quantitative measurement and mensuration in experiments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Innnentes
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ('Innientes') Operative role: these instances indicate 'ad quid aspirandum' — what to strive for if a faculty/facility is available. Use to set practical objectives for intervention when possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Polychrestae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Polychrestus = multi-use bodies/cases; these instances 'sublevant' (support/practical uplift). They are especially valuable in practice and should be subject to sedulous observation (collect polychresti early).

rubrics_metrics.name: Instantiae Magicae
rubrics_metrics.description: A named class of instance (one of the 27 praerogatives) defined here as instances where a small or tenuous material produces a disproportionately large effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed guidance: Bacon describes three modes these 'magical' instances occur in — (1) by multiplication of themselves (e.g., fire, 'specific' venoms that self-multiply), (2) by motions that are transmitted and strengthened 'de rota in rotam' (wheel/axle principle), and (3) by excitation/invitation in another (e.g., magnet exciting many needles), also by fermentation or by 'anteversionem motus' (anticipation of motion, e.g., gunpowder). Investigation notes: the first two modes require study of 'consensuum' (sympathies/antipathies); the third requires measurement of motions. Bacon also flags the question of smallest particles ('per minima') and transposition of subtler matter as lacking clear indications so far.

rubrics_metrics.name: Noting consensuses (sympathies and antipathies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Observe and record consensuses between principal bodies and their subordinate 'fomites' and among bodies (sympathies/antipathies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bacon emphasizes that consensuses between bodies (and between senses and objects) are manifest and should be noted and critically tested; proper notation and keen examination of these consensuses can illuminate latent causal relations. Beware false ascriptions, fables, and superstition when attributing sympathy/antipathy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record materials of putrefactions and generation
rubrics_metrics.description: Note the diverse materials of putrefactions from which 'animalcula' are generated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect and classify the different parent materials and conditions that lead to the generation of small animals/micro-organisms (as part of cataloguing relevant instances).

rubrics_metrics.name: Note lunar/motive consensuses in agriculture and navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Record consensuses between lunar phases/motions and passions of lower bodies (effects on plants, tides, etc.) as indicated by agricultural and nautical experiments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bacon cites accustomed observations linking moon phases to growth, gathering seasons, and tides; such consensuses should be tested experimentally but carefully, with attention to tradition and critical methods (not credulous acceptance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of rare 'secret' consensuses
rubrics_metrics.description: Universal secret consensuses are infrequent and must be inquired into with diligence via trustworthy traditions and reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When an instance or consensus is rare (secretior), seek it through credible traditions and probative narrations, but conduct these inquiries without levity or credulity — with anxious, quasi-doubting faith. Rarity increases the need for careful verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigate modes of union/composition of bodies
rubrics_metrics.description: Study how bodies cohere (coitio/unio) — proclive or difficult unions, by composition or simple apposition, and how materials mix/incorporate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe tendencies of mixing (which materials readily incorporate vs. resist): e.g., powders mix with water, ashes and lime with oils; study collocation of parts, distribution, digestion after mixing, and post-mixture predominance. These observations inform how compositions effect changes and which mixtures yield new properties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Septimus modus: operation by alternation/sequence
rubrics_metrics.description: A seventh mode of operation: perform operations by alternation and vicissitudes of the prior six methods (a series/chain).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bacon notes that arranging the six methods in judicious order and shifting that order can produce especially strong effects; this 'series' method is difficult to understand but yields powerful outcomes. Caution: investigators often lack patience for these complex sequences; yet they are essential for major works.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritise early collection of certain instantiarum
rubrics_metrics.description: From the 27 instances, a subset should be collected from the outset rather than awaited by later particular enquiries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bacon recommends collecting early those instances that most aid both intellect and practice (examples: conformes, monodicae, deviantes, potestatis, januae, innientes, polychrestae, magicae). These select instances are like 'few instead of many' and should be investigated and entered into comparison tables at the start.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make and maintain tabulas comparantiae (comparison tables)
rubrics_metrics.description: Create comparative tables of instances (tabulas comparantiae) that include the privileged/praerogative instances for interpretation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Few privileged instances can stand in for many; when making tables, these should be diligently investigated and recorded. Such tables are essential tools for the Interpreter's work in applying induction to particular natures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Differentiate informational vs. operational uses of instances
rubrics_metrics.description: Classify instances by whether they assist the senses/intellect (informativam) or designate/measure/support practice (operativam).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Informational: aid sense (e.g., Instantiae Lampadis) or intellect (e.g., Solitariae, Migrantes). Operative: designate where to begin (Potestatis), indicate ends to aim for (Innientes), measure (Mathematicae), or uplift practice (Polychrestae, Magicae). Map instance-types to these uses when assembling evidence and planning experiments.
